reference: Frozen baseline B primary; R diagnostic only; no qualification or normalization.
prerequisite: Verified R5 diagnostic decision 393804003767c38f1e9f14e335548324edaa0c769a383874d9904e55a74af7c3 requests independent process control.
design: 24 fresh worker pairs; full factorial startup order x A-workload preconditioning x six B/R/C orders, shuffled once with Python random.Random(7301). Each worker fully loaded before starting the next. Only one worker computes at a time.
cases: All five admitted fixed-logit fixtures, identical source, model, inputs, binaries and sampler controls to R5. No decode or A/B/C qualification.
preconditioning: After both workers load, A-present runs one complete five-case A block with20 repetitions per cell in the baseline worker, before the three warmup blocks. A-absent performs none. All preconditioning output retained and excluded from paired statistics.
timing: Existing unchanged worker monotonic sampling timers. Model loading, process creation, preconditioning, warmup and IPC excluded. No instrumentation during measurement.
statistics: Report per-case and aggregate C/B, R/B and C/R geometric ratios; one-sided95% pair-bootstrap bounds10000 draws seed7301. Pair is unit, retain all24pairs. A-history contrast compares12 A-present vs12 absent pairs; startup contrast compares12 baseline-first vs12 candidate-first pairs using within-condition pair resampling and shared draws across cases.
interpretation: Diagnostic only. A condition effect is supported when the absolute point shift exceeds0.5% and its95% interval excludes1.0; report all cases, no selection/removal. An effect supports a newly preregistered qualification process policy, not automatic source qualification. Persistent material offsets across fresh pairs and both conditions require build/layout investigation. Any ambiguity remains unresolved; do not normalize or promote R.
exclusions: No outcome-based exclusions. Identity mismatch, missing pair/case/arm, decision mismatch, co-tenant JY run, stale/missing placement evidence or observed thermal throttling invalidates the full job; retain evidence and rerun complete job.
